description: Builds Google (or Bing) site: search links for a keyword and a list of domains, or for a recipe. The links are for the user to click; they open in the user's own browser. This tool does not search or read results.

filetype.description: pdf, docx, xlsx and so on

keywords.description: One or more keywords. Several keywords become one OR group (or one link each for inurl:)

own.description: Your own domain, used by recipes that exclude it

recipe.description: Use a recipe's query instead of operator and filters

targets.description: Domains or folders, for example competitor.com or competitor.com/blog/

name: google-links
title: Make Google search links
